name: RH56E2
summary: RH56E2 is INSPIRE ROBOTS' five-finger hand combining six actuated degrees of freedom, 12 joints and force feedback for robotic grasping. The official table specifies six force sensors and a configuration-dependent complement of five to 17 tactile sensor modules. The manufacturer describes power-off self-locking and startup without a homing operation. Modbus TCP and CAN are listed interfaces, with RS485 optional. Published figures include a 790 ±10 g mass, ±0.2 mm repeatability and a 30 N maximum fingertip output, which should be interpreted as manufacturer specifications for the stated configu

description.en: RH56E2 is INSPIRE ROBOTS' five-finger hand combining six actuated degrees of freedom, 12 joints and force feedback for robotic grasping. The official table specifies six force sensors and a configuration-dependent complement of five to 17 tactile sensor modules. The manufacturer describes power-off self-locking and startup without a homing operation. Modbus TCP and CAN are listed interfaces, with RS485 optional. Published figures include a 790 ±10 g mass, ±0.2 mm repeatability and a 30 N maximum fingertip output, which should be interpreted as manufacturer specifications for the stated configuration.
